name: saanssafe-video
description: SaansSafe hackathon submission video (Remotion + Playwright captures)

scripts.render:draft: node scripts/music.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts SaansSafeDraft out/saanssafe-v2-draft.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:final: node scripts/music.mjs --final && remotion render src/index.ts SaansSafeFinal out/saanssafe-v2-final.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:music: node scripts/music.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts SaansSafeMusicOnly out/saanssafe-final-music-only.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=3 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912
